title: The ALMA-CRISTAL survey: Extended [CII] emission in an interacting galaxy system at z ∼ 5.5
question: What are the morphology and kinematics of the cold gas, star-forming and stellar components of CRISTAL-05/HZ3 at z=5.54, and what is the origin of its extended [CII] emission?

what.value: Dust continuum flux density S158um = 0.118 ± 0.021 mJy; dust effective radius 1.4 ± 0.6 kpc; HST/F160W circularized radius 0.36 ± 0.02 kpc

evidence.quote: The dust emission was measured by (cite: 2023Mitsuhashi), yielding a flux density of S$_{158\mu m}$ = 0.118 $\pm$ 0.021 mJy.
the stellar mass log M$_{*}$/M$_{\odot}$ = 10.27 obtained by (cite: 2015capak)

what.value: FIR conversion factor nuLnu(158um)/L_FIR = 0.185 and SED scaling for Td=45 K, beta=1.5

recipe.goal: Calibrate, combine and image ALMA data
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration per program, concat, uvcontsub, tclean with auto-multithresh down to nsigma=1, JvM correction
Spectrum in 1.5" aperture, single-Gaussian fit (also two-Gaussian)
Moment-0/1/2 from natural-weighted cube over [-280,+280] km/s with 3 rms clip; PV slit along major axis 10 pixels wide

recipe.goal: Compare sizes and radial profiles across wavelengths
recipe.method: Degrade HST/JWST PSF to ALMA beam; elliptical annuli 0.3" wide with q=0.6; Sersic n=1 visibility-fit radius
Fellwalker on non-JvM cubes; MINPIX=16, FLATSLOPE=2 rms, MINDIP in [1,2,3] sigma, MAXJUMP in [4,6,8] pixels
1D DYSMALpy with disk (n=1)+bulge (n=4, B/T=30%)+NFW halo (c=3) fit to symmetrized rotation and dispersion curves
key_parameters: 1000 walkers, 50 burn-in steps, 200 run steps; inclination 60 deg; free: fdm, disk r_eff, sigma0
assumptions: gas-mass ratio log Mgas/M* = 0.75; isotropic constant dispersion; no adiabatic contraction

recipe.method: Mdyn = gamma R v^2 / G using circularized Gaussian radii
assumptions: gamma = 5 and v~sigma for C05-SE; v=120 km/s at R=1.5 kpc for NW

recipe.method: Beam-sized apertures (0.33"), dust flux converted to L_FIR with factor 0.185 for Td=45 K, beta=1.5; compare with local and ALPINE galaxies
assumptions: Td = 45 K, beta=1.5, uncertainty from Td 40-60 K

evidence.quote: line flux of 1.00 $\pm$ 0.07 Jy km s$^{-1}$
46%, 13%, and 41% of the total emission of the system, respectively
M$_{\rm dyn}^{\rm NW} = 5 \times 10^{9}$ M$_{\odot}$, M$_{\rm dyn}^{\rm SE} = 9.1 \times 10^{8}$ M$_{\odot}$
notably high average value of $79\pm 21$ kms$^{-1}$
